{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Identify sentinel values
sentinel_value = -999.0

# Filter for severe disease
severe_df = trial_df[trial_df['severity'] == 'severe']

# Check if any biomarker_baseline values are sentinel
sentinel_count = severe_df[severe_df['biomarker_baseline'] == sentinel_value].shape[0]

# Compute mean baseline biomarker value for severe patients, excluding sentinel values
mean_biomarker_severe = severe_df[severe_df['biomarker_baseline'] != sentinel_value]['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

sentinel_count, mean_biomarker_severe"}
